classes.proven: a dated record shows the value was available on or before the decision (official release calendar, retrieval time recorded at retrieval, or a batch sealed by a commit no later than the day after the decision)
classes.estimated: only a typical latency documented by the producer; the value available on a past date is not archived
classes.unknown: neither an archived version nor a usable latency

principle: a historical file downloaded today shows today's version of that date; it does not prove that this version existed on the past decision date

sources.use: published municipal yields (lags) and the target
sources.historical: proven for releases 2016-2025 (IBGE release calendar); releases before 2016 estimated as 31 Oct of the following year
sources.revisions: IBGE may revise; the registry target is the first release

sources.producer: NASA GPM IMERG Early Run V07 (GES DISC GPM_3IMERGDE)
sources.historical: estimated; V07 Early was produced again in retrospective processing (completed Aug 2024), so today's 2016-2023 values are not the ones available at the time
sources.prospective: proven if granule name, version and retrieval time are recorded

sources.producer: NASA GPM IMERG Late Run V07 (GES DISC GPM_3IMERGDL)
sources.latency: about 14 hours after the end of the UTC day (half-hourly target), daily file thereafter
sources.historical: estimated; retrospectively reprocessed V07 (minor versions such as V07B, V07C) - the archived value of a past day is not the one available then
sources.prospective: proven: granule name/version per day and retrieval time recorded by the live provider (sidecar files since 2026-11-14 afternoon; earlier cache files only by file time, proven by same-day sealing)

sources.use: rain of the training cohorts (POWER IMERG_PRECTOT)
sources.producer: NASA GPM IMERG Final Run V07 via NASA POWER
sources.historical: estimated; violates available_at <= decision_at at every annual cutoff (availability audit v8)
sources.prospective: not available at decision; usable only as a retrospective reference

sources.use: temperature, humidity, wind, dew point, pressure (features and ET0)
sources.producer: NASA POWER: MERRA-2 extended near real time with GEOS (FP-IT / GEOS-IT)
sources.latency: GEOS segment within several days of real time (about 2 days in POWER documentation); MERRA-2 within about one to several months
sources.historical: unknown: the near-real-time GEOS values available at a past decision were later replaced by MERRA-2 in the POWER series; no archived vintage
sources.prospective: proven by recording the POWER response hash and retrieval time; the values may later be replaced, so the recorded hash is the reference

sources.producer: NASA POWER: CERES SYN1deg (about 3-4 months) with CERES FLASHFlux V4A near real time (about 5-7 days); POWER notes a SYN1deg processing delay since August 2024
sources.historical: unknown: FLASHFlux values available then were later replaced by SYN1deg
sources.prospective: proven by recording the POWER response hash and retrieval time

sources.use: radiation for recent days without POWER radiation (live service)
sources.producer: ECMWF ERA5 via the Open-Meteo archive API
sources.latency: ERA5T about 5 days; replaced by final ERA5 about 2-3 months later (rarely different, e.g. 2021 and 2024 issues)
sources.historical: estimated: the archive now returns final ERA5, not the ERA5T available then
sources.prospective: proven by recording retrieval time per day (live provider sidecar)

sources.use: ground truth for rain products only (not a model input)
sources.latency: hourly, near real time; annual consolidated files later
sources.historical: estimated (consolidated files may include later corrections)
estimated unless previous runs are archived
sources.prospective: proven: issued_at and available_at recorded in the water-projection contract

consequence_for_development_years: every replay of 2016-2025 with Early/Late/ERA5 uses today's archived values: a retrospective evaluation with operational-type sources, not a real-time replay
